changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'fusion' AND TABLE_NAME = 'StagingRelationUnresolved_backup') BEGIN drop table fusion.StagingRelationUnresolved_backup; END
changeSet.rollback: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'fusion' AND TABLE_NAME = 'StagingRelationUnresolved_backup') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [fusion].[StagingRelationUnresolved_backup]( [ID] [bigint] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [StartID] [varchar](500) NOT NULL, [EndID] [varchar](500) NOT NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_FusionStagingRelationUnresolved_CreatedOn] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_FusionStagingRelationUnresolved] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
